name: Exp_JMASlope
summary: This EA trades based on the JMASlope indicator, which measures the slope of a Jurik Moving Average. It supports two entry algorithms: zero-line breakthrough (breakdown) and direction change (twist), opening buy/sell positions when the slope signals momentum shifts.
summary_zh: 该EA基于JMASlope指标进行交易，该指标衡量Jurik移动平均线的斜率。它支持两种入场算法：零线突破（breakdown）和方向改变（twist），当斜率信号显示动量转变时开仓买入或卖出。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用JMASlope指标作为核心策略，JMASlope是Jurik移动平均线的斜率指标，用于衡量价格动量的方向和强度。入场条件有两种模式：breakdown模式是当斜率从负转正时买入，从正转负时卖出，即零线突破策略；twist模式是当斜率由降转升时买入，由升转降时卖出，即方向扭转策略。出场条件包括止损和止盈，默认止损1000点、止盈2000点，同时也根据反向信号平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的函数实现，支持按存款比例或固定手数两种模式。策略整体上是一个动量跟踪系统，在多周期框架下运行，默认使用H4周期。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the JMASlope indicator as its core strategy, which measures the slope of a Jurik Moving Average to gauge price momentum direction and strength. Entry conditions are available in two modes: breakdown mode triggers a buy when the slope crosses above zero and a sell when it crosses below zero, implementing a zero-line breakout strategy; twist mode triggers a buy when the slope turns from declining to rising and a sell when it turns from rising to declining, implementing a direction-reversal strategy. Exit conditions include a fixed stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points by default, along with signal-based position closing when the opposite signal appears. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit per deal. Money management relies on external functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, supporting both deposit-proportional and fixed-lot sizing modes. Overall, the strategy is a momentum-following system operating on a multi-timeframe basis, defaulting to the H4 timeframe.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为手数
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter controlling lot size ratio or fixed lot

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: 入场算法：零线突破或方向改变
parameters.description_en: Entry algorithm: zero-line breakout or direction change

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 双模式入场算法提供灵活性，可根据市场状态切换突破或扭转策略
Jurik移动平均线是高质量平滑算法，比普通MA滞后性更低，信号更及时
完善的开关控制，可独立控制买卖开仓和平仓权限
使用新K线检测避免同一根K线内重复交易
多时间框架支持，可灵活选择指标周期
pros_en: Dual-mode entry algorithm provides flexibility to switch between breakthrough and twist strategies based on market conditions
Jurik Moving Average is a high-quality smoothing algorithm with less lag than standard MAs, producing more timely signals
Comprehensive toggle controls allow independent management of buy/sell opening and closing permissions
New bar detection prevents repeated trading within the same bar
Multi-timeframe support allows flexible indicator period selection
cons: 缺乏扩展点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动率（ATR）自适应调整
未对已有持仓方向进行检查，可能在同方向重复开仓
依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，核心交易逻辑不透明
无回撤保护机制，连续亏损时没有最大回撤限制
cons_en: Lacks spread filtering, which may result in unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
Stop loss and take profit are fixed point values without ATR-based volatility adaptation
No check for existing position direction, potentially leading to duplicate same-direction entries
Depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, making core trading logic opaque
No drawdown protection mechanism or maximum drawdown limit during consecutive losses
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自适应调整止损止盈距离
添加持仓方向检查和最大持仓数量限制，避免同方向重复开仓和过度杠杆
增加点差过滤和滑点保护，在点差过大时暂停交易以保护成交质量
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit that adapts to current market volatility
Add position direction check and maximum position count limit to prevent duplicate entries and overleveraging
Add spread filter and slippage protection to pause trading when spreads are excessively wide

risk_points: 固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率，低波动时止损过远造成不必要损失，高波动时止盈过近错过行情
无持仓方向检查，可能在同方向重复开仓导致过度集中风险
MM参数为负值时表示固定手数，用户可能误解参数含义导致仓位过大
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss/take profit without volatility consideration: stops may be too wide in low volatility causing unnecessary losses, or take profit too close in high volatility missing moves
No position direction check may lead to duplicate same-direction entries causing excessive concentration risk
Negative MM parameter meaning fixed lot size may be misunderstood by users, potentially leading to oversized positions
